---
id: wandering-albatross
title: Wandering albatross
---
The wandering albatross (*Diomedea exulans*) has the largest wingspan of
any living bird. Dynamic soaring extracts energy from vertical wind shear
over Southern Ocean swell. Adults may stay at sea for years between
visits to a natal island. Salt glands dump seawater. Nests are raised
mounds of mud and grass.
